historical_experiment_check.exp-20260504-034: Prior >=500k single-event Form 4 satellite, positive but immaterial.
historical_experiment_check.exp-20260508-028: Same clustered open-market buy rule; positive but immaterial on ~49 tickers / 234 buys.
historical_experiment_check.exp-20260512-101: Multi-owner buy cluster observed-only on the narrow sample.
historical_experiment_check.single_changed_variable: ONLY the insider sample breadth changed (broad SEC backfill, exp-20260613-023); rule/params identical.
historical_experiment_check.why_not_forbidden_retry: The narrow rejections were sample-size only with no forbidden-retry note; a larger sample is the explicit new evidence, not a threshold retune.

hypothesis: Clustered/multi-owner PIT-safe Form 4 open-market purchases, re-run on the broad historical insider sample (49->611 tickers, 234->3901 buys), give a positive standalone default-off event sleeve whose three-window aggregate EV/PnL lift is now material at adequate sample, where the narrow exp-20260508-028 replay was positive-but-immaterial.

market_regime_summary.mid_weak: rotation-heavy bull where strategy makes money but lags indexes
market_regime_summary.old_thin: mixed-to-weak older tape with lower win rate

parameters.cluster_definition: same ticker has >=2 meaningful event days in 30d, or owner_count_30d >=2, or current event owner_count >=2

production_impact.promotion_blocker_if_positive: A shared default-off Form 4 cluster queue/paper adapter must be wired in run.py + replay with parity tests and a live-realistic execution envelope before any trade-enabled promotion.

single_causal_variable: breadth of the insider sample (broad backfill) for the SAME clustered Form 4 open-market purchase event rule as exp-20260508-028
